svg.title: Completed Qualification and Scope Boundary Record
svg.desc: Completed fictional Maya Chen scope record showing fit conditions, exclusions, client responsibilities, acceptance, uncertainty routing, and change handling for the Expansion-Ready Website System.
svg.text: PRODUCTIZE YOUR DEV SKILLS · WORKBOOK PP. 17–20
The commercial boundary is designed before the proposal has to defend it.

g.text: Real transition exposes website operating constraints
Cosmetic redesign with no fit to the system
Expansion, campaign, rebrand, or vendor transition
Impossible deadline that prevents agreed QA/approval
Customer portal or unknown application obligation
Named decision owner and access to required facts
No owner for approvals or required information
Approved facts, content, accounts, and vendor access available
Required access or authorized content unavailable
Buyer accepts defined scope and change process
Unlimited revisions or open-ended work expected
Architecture, approved content implementation, service/location templates, lead capture, CRM handoff, analytics,
migration, QA, deployment, documentation, and stabilization.
Customer portal, custom CRM, paid-media management, ongoing SEO campaign, brand identity, and unreviewed
One decision owner, approved business facts/content, account access, legal/compliance approval, and timely reviews.
Agreed functions deployed; form, analytics, and migration tests pass; critical agreed defects resolved;
Clarification, defects, and agreed revisions stay in their original category. Changed requirements or new obligations receive an explicit trade-off.
